shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts && for file in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js'; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$file"; cat "$file"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css && git diff -- package.json && rg --files --hidden -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm --version && npm ls next react typescript vitest --depth=0 && ls -la /workspace /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|req\\.query|req\\.body|NextApi(Request|Response)' app components lib types && true"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && rg --files app components lib types && curl -I --max-time 20 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=5'"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && cat tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts && rg -n '\"/blog(/(1|11))?\"|initialRevalidateSeconds|fallback' .next/prerender-manifest.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)([\\x27\\x22])|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|req\\.query|req\\.body|NextApi(Request|Response)' app components lib types; test "'! -d pages && test ! -d src/pages && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg --files app components lib types tests && test ! -d pages && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && test ! -d pages && git diff -- tsconfig.json && ps -eo pid,ppid,args | rg '"'next start|next-server|npm run start'"
